items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Herb Moran? I was a play with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's my alto back there. Yeah. People would cost three heads, and they'd go cost three heads of my alto. Yeah. And then they'd talk so she'd pull up my attic. Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm.
What about, uh, Herb Moran? Did you ever know him?
Herb Moran? I was a play with him. Oh, yeah? Yeah. Herb Moran trumpet player? Yeah. Yeah. I'd play with his brother's drummer, McGee.
